Ruesga Farms has an exclusive winter program between December – February.

In the Heart of Puerto Vallarta, MX.

Our winter program farms harvest over 4 million pounds through the months of December to February. All size high-quality watermelons are available along with seeded and seedless variety. The natural weather and rain in the San Vicente and Puerto Vallarta area provide excellent produce flavor, color, and taste!

OUR HISTORY

More than 10 decades later we’ve have grown produce for consumers markets in the US and Mexico.

Farming Since 1920s

Out of the little town of San Vicente, Nayarit a few minutes away from the beautiful beaches of Puerto Vallarta, Ruesga Farms is located. Boasting year-round sunny skies and tropical weather year after year.

The culture behind our farms is simple, to inspire others and grow quality crop. Our farms are known for growing beans, corn, cucumbers, stevia, and watermelon.

Our establishment has been around since the 1920s with Jose Ruesga a family-man set on a new adventure to start a family farm. Ruesga farms started off with only 10 acres of beans and the determination of a family business to help provide for others.

Ruesga Farms

A true family farm, where honesty and integrity continue to grow.

Out of the little town of San Vicente, Nayarit a few minutes away from the beautiful beaches of Puerto Vallarta, Ruesga Farms is located. Boasting year-round sunny skies and tropical weather year after year. The culture behind our farms is simple, to inspire others and grow quality crop. Our family farms were established years ago in the year 1924. Our farms grow beans, corn, cucumbers, stevia, and watermelon.

OUR HISTORY

Our establishment has been around since the 1920s with Jose Ruesga a family-man set on a new adventure to start a family farm. Ruesga farms started off with only 10 acres of beans and the determination of a family business to help provide for others.

More than 10 decades later we’ve have grown produce for consumers markets in the US and Mexico.
